message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Yang used his position (village committee) to divert village funds (pre-collected construction fees) for his own business, then later returned the money. This is classic "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) or "挪用集体资金". In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "挪用公款罪" (embezzlement of public funds) when a public official misappropriates public funds. Since he is a village committee member (public official) and used village collective funds, it's "挪用公款罪". The examples: earlier example with Wang3 (expenditure) gave "挪用公款". So answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "受贿"? No, he didn't receive bribes, he misappropriated funds. So single crime.
